Friends
919 - The one with Rachel's dream

Teleplay: Mark Kunerth
Story: Dana Klein
Directed by: Terry Hughes
Transcribed by: Eleonora, Pheeboh, Sebastiano & Vanessa

[Scene: Rachel and Joey's apartment]

Joey: (talking to a pineapple in his hand) God, you're beautiful...why are we fighting this?
（对着手里的菠萝）天哪，你真美……我们为什么要抗拒这份感情？You know you want it to happen as much as I do.
你知道，你也和我一样渴望这件事。

(Rachel comes out of her room and starts staring at him unseen)

Joey: I want you.
我想要你。I need you.
我需要你。Let me make love to you.
让我好好爱你。

Rachel: I don't wanna stand in the way of true love or anything, but I think a cantaloupe might hurt less.
我不想妨碍真爱或其他任何事情，但我认为哈密瓜可能不会那么痛。

Joey: Oh, ehm...I'm...I'm rehearsing my lines.
哦，嗯……我……我在排练台词。They gave me a big romantic story on Days Of Our Lives.
《我们的日子》给我安排了一条重头爱情线。 It's the first time my character's got one.
这是我的角色第一次拥有它。 I'm so nervous, you know, I really want it to be good!
我很紧张，你知道，我真的希望一切顺利！

Rachel: Woow!
哇！I haven't seen you this worked up since you did that dog food commercial and you thought you were gonna be with a real talking dog!
自从你拍狗粮广告、以为真能跟一只会说话的狗合作之后，我就没见你这么激动过！

Joey: Yeah, that was a disappointment...(pause) Oh, hey!
是啊，那次可真让人失望……（停顿）对了！D'you want to come down to the set and tell me if I'm doing ok?
你要不要来片场看看，帮我判断演得好不好？

Rachel: (excited) Are you serious?
（兴奋）你是认真的吗？

Joey: Yeah!
当然！Hey, you just have to promise not to get yourself thrown out again.
不过你得保证，这回别又被人赶出去。

Rachel: Hey, that was an honest mistake!
嘿，这是一个无心的错误！

Joey: Right!(he starts to ape her)"Oh my God, is this the men's room?
对！（他开始模仿她）“天哪，这是男厕所吗？ Oh, I feel so foolish, have you always known you wanted to be an actor?"
哦，我觉得自己很傻，你一直都知道你想成为一名演员吗？” (he inclines his head as if to look at a man's private parts)

Rachel: Yeah, that was an awesome day!
是的，那是很棒的一天！

Opening credits

[Scene: Central Perk]

Monica: Hey!
嘿！

Phoebe: Hey!
嘿！

Ross: Hi!
你好！

Monica: So, do you guys wanna come and eat dinner at the restaurant sometime in the next few weeks?
那么，你们想在接下来的几周内某个时候来餐厅吃晚饭吗？

Phoebe: Sure!
当然！

Ross: I'd love to!
我喜欢！

Monica: Well you can't!
好吧，你不能！ We're booked solid for the next month!
我们下个月的订单已经满了！

Phoebe: Well, I can't give you a massage, because my licence has been revoked again!
好吧，我不能给你按摩了，因为我的执照又被吊销了！

Ross: Phoebe, what happened?
菲比，发生什么事了？

Phoebe: Well, it was an accident...You know, it's a lot of oil and sometimes the hand just slips!
嗯，这是一次意外……你知道，油很多，有时手会滑倒！

(Chandler enters)

Chandler: (To Monica) Have I got a surprise for you?
（对莫妮卡）我给你准备了惊喜吗？ Pack your bags!
收拾好你的行李！

Phoebe: Oh no!
哦，不！You guys aren't supposed to get divorced for 7 years!
你们不是应该七年之后才离婚吗！

Chandler: What?
什么？ No, I'm taking Monica to a romantic inn in Vermont (shows them a brochure)!
不，我要带莫妮卡去佛蒙特州的一家浪漫旅馆（给他们看一本小册子）！

Phoebe: Oh, good!
哦，那就好！Ok, good for you!
好啊，真替你们高兴！Try to recapture the magic!
试着重燃爱火吧！

Chandler: So, what do you say?
那么，你说呢？ Can you get out of work?
你能下班吗？

Monica: Oh, honey!
亲爱的！I can't.
我不行。 I was just telling these guys that things are crazy at the restaurant!
我只是告诉这些家伙餐厅里的事情太疯狂了！

Chandler: Are you really that busy?
你真的有那么忙吗？

Monica: Yeah, I'm sorry.
是的，对不起。 I really am.
我确实是。

Chandler: Oh, that's ok.
哦，没关系。I'll just try and reschedule.
我再试着改个时间。 (on the phone) "Hi, this is Chandler Bing.
（在电话中）“嗨，我是钱德勒·宾。 I made a reservation there and I need to change it (pause) Oh, what do you mean it's not refundable?
我在那里订了房，需要改签（停顿）哦，什么意思，不能退款？ Can I just come some other time?
我可以改天来吗？ (pause) Oh, can't you make an exception?"
（停顿）哦，你就不能破例吗？”

Monica: Tell them I'm a chef in a big New York restaurant!
告诉他们我是纽约一家大餐厅的厨师！

Phoebe: And tell them that in 2 weeks I will once again be a masseuse in good standing!
并告诉他们两周后我将再次成为一名信誉良好的女按摩师！

Chandler: (on the phone) "Look, this is ridiculous!
（在电话里）“看，这太荒谬了！ I'm not paying for that room!
我不付那个房间的钱！ Ok?"
好的？” (pause) "Oh, thank you very much!"
（停顿）“哦，非常感谢！” (hangs up) Yeah, I'm going to Vermont...
（挂断）是的，我要去佛蒙特州......

Ross: Oh, don't worry about it!
哦，别担心！ Just use your travel insurance.
只需使用您的旅行保险即可。

Chandler: I don't have travel insurance.
我没有旅行保险。

Ross: Well, this is what happens when people live on the edge!
好吧，这就是当人们生活在边缘时会发生的事情！

Monica: Why don't you take Ross?
你为什么不带罗斯去？

Ross: Uh, don't you think that would be a little weird?
呃，你不觉得这有点奇怪吗？ I mean, two guys in a romantic inn...
我是说，两个人在一家浪漫的旅馆里......

Monica: No, not if their room has two beds!
不，如果他们的房间有两张床就不会！

Ross: (browsing the brochure) I guess...It still seems a little...(enthusiastically) moonlight boat ride!!
（浏览小册子）我想……看起来还是有点……（热情地）月光船之旅！

[Scene: Days of Our Lives' Studios]

Rachel: Hey Joey, is this the bed where Olivia lost her virginity?
嘿乔伊，这是奥利维亚失去童贞的床吗？

Joey: I don't know, but one of the extras sure did!
不知道，不过确实有个群众演员在这张床上失去了童贞！ (pause) Hey, listen Rach.
（停顿）嘿，听着，瑞秋。 Thanks again for coming down to watch my scenes!
再次感谢您过来观看我的场景！

Rachel: Oh, please!
别这么说！Honey, just the fact that you want me here to support you, I'm...OH MY GOD!
亲爱的，光是你希望我来支持你这件事，就让我……天哪！Is that Christian Sanders?
那是克里斯蒂安·桑德斯吗？He's so gorgeous!
他太帅了！

Joey: Also so gay!
还这么gay！

Rachel: Oh, in my head he's done some pretty "not-gay-stuff"!
哦，在我看来，他做了一些漂亮的“非同性恋的事情”！

Joey: Well, at the Christmas party him and Santa did some definitely gay stuff!
嗯，在圣诞晚会上他和圣诞老人​​做了一些绝对同性恋的事情！

Director: Joey, Joey!
乔伊，乔伊！ We're ready for you!
我们已经为您准备好了！

Joey: Oh, wish me luck!
哦，祝我好运！

Rachel: Ok, not that you need it but good...GOD!
虽然你不需要，不过祝你……天哪！Is that Chase Lassiter?
那是蔡斯·拉西特吗？He's straight, right?
他是异性恋，对吧？

Joey: Rach, I gotta say...if you weren't here wondering if these guys were gay I don't know if I could do this!
瑞秋，我得说……如果你不在这里想知道这些家伙是不是同性恋，我不知道我是否能做到这一点！

Rachel: Oh, I'm sorry, you're right.
哦，抱歉，你说得对。I'm sorry, good luck!
抱歉，祝你好运！ (they hug)

Director: On a bell please!
请按铃！ Quietly..
悄悄.. and ACTION!
开拍！

(the scene starts.Joey enters and there's a girl wearing a wedding dress near a bed)

Actress/Olivia: Drake!
德雷克！ What are you doing in here?
你在这里做什么？

Joey/Drake: Stopping you from marrying the wrong man and making the biggest mistake of your life.
阻止你嫁给错误的男人并犯下你一生中最大的错误。

Actress/Olivia: Get out!
出去！

Joey/Drake: You don't love him!
你不爱他！

Actress/Olivia: What do you know about love?
关于爱情，你了解多少？

Joey/Drake: I know what I felt that night when we kissed under the bridge.
我知道那天晚上我们在桥下接吻时我的感受。

Actress/Olivia: That kiss never happened.
那个吻从未发生过。

Joey/Drake: Oh, what about this one.
哦，这个呢。

(the actress slaps him)

Rachel: (watching a television where the scene is shown, startled) OH!
（看着电视里的场景，吓了一跳）哦！

Actress/Olivia: No, I told you...get out!
不，我告诉过你……滚出去！

Joey/Drake: Fine.
好吧。 I'll go.
我去吧。 But let me ask you one question...
但让我问你一个问题...

Chase Lassiter: (talking to Rachel) You look familiar, have we...
（对瑞秋说话）你看起来很眼熟，我们……

Rachel: SSSHHHHTTT!!
嘘！！He's asking her a question!!
他在问她问题呢！！

Joey/Drake: Can you really live the rest of your life never knowing what we could have been?
你真的能在余生中永远不知道我们本来可以做什么吗？

Actress/Olivia: I don't have a choice...
我别无选择...

Joey/Drake: Yes, you do.
你有选择的。Yes...you do.
你真的……有。 I'm the one who doesn't have a choice because I...because I can't stop loving you.
我是那个别无选择的人，因为我……因为我无法停止爱你。

Actress/Olivia: Don't say that...
别这么说...

Joey/Drake: Tell me to stop, just...tell me to stop.
告诉我停下来，只是……告诉我停下来。 (he's about to kiss her)

Director: CUT!
停！

Rachel: NO!
不！ (pause) Or, cut!
（停顿）或者，喊停也行！You know, that's your call!
当然，这由你决定！

[Scene: Monica's restaurant]

1st Customer: Everything was delicious!
一切都很美味！

Monica: Thank you!
谢谢你！

2nd Customer: It was.
是的。 The duck in particular was superb.
特别是鸭子非常棒。

Monica: Thank you!(she looks at the 3rd customer waiting for a compliment) You haven't said anything...
谢谢！（她看着第三位顾客，等待赞美）你什么也没说……

3rd Customer: Actually I do have one small complaint.
事实上我确实有一个小抱怨。

Monica: Oh..please!
哦，拜托！I-I welcome criticism.
我很欢迎批评。

3rd Customer: The musician right outside the restaurant...it's kind of a mood-killer!
餐厅外面的音乐家……这有点破坏情绪！

Monica: What musician?
什么音乐家？

[Scene: Outside the restaurant]

Phoebe: (playing guitar and singing) And there's a country called Argentinaaaa, it's a place I've never seeeeen.
（弹吉他唱歌）还有一个国家叫阿根廷aaa，这是一个我从未见过的地方。 But I'm told for fifty pesos you can buy a human spleen.
但我听说只要五十比索就可以买一个人的脾脏。 Humaaan spleeeeen.
人类的脾——脏。 Olè!
噢！

Monica: What are you doing here!
你在这里做什么！

Phoebe: Well, you said that you had customers lined up in the street, so I am here to entertain!
嗯，你说你们街上有顾客排队，所以我是来招待的！

Monica: Great!
真棒！

Phoebe: Yeah!
是的！ It really has been great too, you know, some of this people must have seen me play before because they were requesting a bunch of my songs!
这真的也很棒，你知道，其中一些人以前一定看过我演奏，因为他们需要我的一堆歌曲！ Yeah, "You suck" and "shut up and go home".
是的，“你很糟糕”和“闭嘴回家”。

Monica: Listen Phoebe...
听着菲比...

Phoebe: Yeah.
是的。

Monica: You know how much I love listening to your music, you know, but...
你知道我有多喜欢听你的音乐，但是……

Phoebe: But what?
但什么？

Monica: This is kind of a classy place.
这是一个优雅的地方。

Phoebe: (pause) Ok, say no more.
（停顿）好吧，不用再说了。

[Time lapse: Phoebe in front of restaurant again]

Phoebe: (with a fancy dress, still playing and singing): It wasn't just that she was fat, the woman smelled like garbage!
（一身奇装异服，还在弹唱）：不光是胖，这女人身上有股垃圾味！ Everyone!
每个人！ It wasn't just that she was fat the woman smelled like garbaaaaaage!
不只是因为她胖，这个女人身上还带着一股垃圾味！ (to Monica, showing her dress) Classy, uh?
（向莫妮卡展示她的衣服）优雅，嗯？

(Monica covers her face with her hands)

[Scene: hall of the romantic inn in Vermont]

Chandler: Hi, Chandler Bing, I have a reservation.
嗨，钱德勒·宾，我有预订。

Receptionist: Welcome to the Chestnut Inn Mr. Bing, so where are you joining from?
欢迎来到栗子旅馆，宾先生，你们从哪儿来？

Chandler: New York.
纽约。

Ross: (in a strange voice and eating candies) The big apple!
（用一种奇怪的声音，吃着糖果）大苹果！

Chandler: I'm sorry, he's a little bit wound up, we had to stop at every maple candy stand on the way here.
抱歉，他有点兴奋过头了，来时每一个枫糖摊我们都停了下来。

Ross: Yeah, I ate all my gifts for everybody.
是的，我把送给大家的礼物都吃了。

Receptionist: I am sorry Mr. Bing, there's no record of your reservation in the computer.
抱歉，宾先生，电脑里没有您的预订记录。

Chandler: Well, that's impossible, can you check again, please?
嗯，那是不可能的，你能再检查一下吗？

Ross: (high pitched voice) Check again please!
（高声调）请再检查一次！

Receptionist: I'm sorry, it's not here.
抱歉，它不在这里。

Ross: Not there.
不在那里。

Chandler: Let me get this straight.
让我说清楚。 I called yesterday trying to cancel my reservation and I was told it was not refundable, then we drove six hours all the way up here and now you tell me that we don't have a reservation?
我昨天打电话试图取消预订，却被告知不可退款，然后我们一路开车六个小时来到这里，现在你告诉我我们没有预订？

Receptionist: I don't know what to say.
我不知道该说什么。

Ross: (mumbling) She doesn't know what to say!
（嘟囔）她不知道该说什么！

Chandler: Just give us the cheapest room you have.
只需给我们您最便宜的房间即可。

Receptionist: Unfortunatly the only thing we have available is our deluxe suite, the rate is six hundred dollars.
不幸的是，我们唯一可用的是我们的豪华套房，价格是六百美元。

Chandler: That's insane!
太疯狂了！

Ross: Totally insane.
完全疯了。 Dude, let's drive home, we'll hit all the maple candy stores on the way back and if...if they're closed maybe we'll tap a tree and make some ourselves.
伙计，我们开车回家吧，回来的路上我们会逛遍所有的枫糖店，如果……如果它们关门了，也许我们会敲一棵树，自己做一些。

Chandler: Does that room have a closet I can lock him in?
那个房间有壁橱可以把他锁进去吗？ (pause) We'll take it.
（停顿）我们会接受的。

Receptionist: Great.
好。

Chandler: (aside, to Ross) What!?
（一旁，对罗斯）什么！？ They are totally ripping us off!
他们完全是在欺骗我们！

Ross: Dude, don't worry 'bout it!
老兄，别担心！ I know how we can make your money back!
我知道我们怎样才能赚回你的钱！ This is a nice hotel, you know, plenty of amenities, we just load up on those!
这是一家不错的酒店，您知道，有很多便利设施，我们只是装载这些！ Like those apples.
就像那些苹果一样。 Instead of taking one, I'm...
别只拿一个，我…… I take six!
我拿六个！

Chandler: Great, at a hundred dollars an apple, we're there!
太棒了，一个苹果一百美元，我们就到了！

Ross: C'mon, you get the idea, ow-ow-ow we'll make our money back in no time!
来吧，你明白了，哇哦我们很快就能把钱赚回来！

Chandler: Dude, you're shaking!
兄弟，你在发抖！

Ross: I think it's the sugar, could you hold the apple?
我认为是糖，你能拿着苹果吗？

[Scene: Joey's apartment]

Rachel: Hi!
你好！

Joey: Hey!
嘿！

Rachel: Joey, I gotta tell ya, I've been thinking all day about that scene you did, I mean, you were amazing!
乔伊，我得告诉你，我一整天都在想你所做的那个场景，我的意思是，你太棒了！

Joey: Oh, you know, the writing was good, and the director is good, and...
哦，你知道，编剧很好，导演也很好，而且...... and my co-star's good but they're not as good as me!
我的搭档也不错，但他们不如我！

Rachel: God, you have to tell me what happens tomorrow!
天哪，你一定要告诉我明天会发生什么！

Joey: Ow, I'm just going over the script now!
噢，我现在正在看剧本！ You wanna read lines with me?
你想和我一起读台词吗？

Rachel: Me?
我？ Oh, no, I am not an actress.
哦，不，我不是演员。

Joey: Oh, all right, I can ask Monica.
哦，好吧，我可以问问莫妮卡。

Rachel: Oh screw her, that part is mine!
管她呢，这角色归我了！

Joey: Right...
对…… (pause) ok, so just from the top of the page, right here.
（停顿）好的，就从页面顶部开始，就在这里。

Rachel: Okay.
好的。 (pause).(acting) Hello Drake, I'm surprised to see you here.
（停顿）。（表演）你好，Drake，我很惊讶在这里见到你。

Joey/Drake: I can't believe you married him.
我不敢相信你嫁给了他。

Rachel/actress: But what choice did I have.
但我有什么选择呢。 He was keeping my sister in a dungeon!
他把我妹妹关在地牢里！

Joey/Drake: So what about us?
那么我们呢？ Everything we feel for each other.
我们对彼此的一切感受。

Rachel/actress: It's over!
结束了！ You have to accept that.
你必须接受这一点。

Joey/Drake: How can I?
我该怎么办？ Knowing I'll never hold you in my arms again, or touch your skin, or feel your lips, knowing I'll never make love to you?
知道我永远不会再把你抱在怀里，或触摸你的皮肤，或感觉你的嘴唇，知道我永远不会和你做爱吗？ How can I accept that...
我怎么能接受这个... I can never kiss you again when it's all I can do not to kiss you right now.
我此刻拼命克制着才没吻你，又怎么接受以后永远不能吻你？

Rachel: (pause) Kiss me.
（停顿）吻我。

Joey: What?
什么？

Rachel: Kiss me.
吻我。

Joey: Ah, Rach, it doesn't say that!
啊，瑞秋，它没有这么说！

Rachel: No, I'm saying...
不，我是说...

Joey: but, but..
但是，但是..

Rachel: just...
只是... don't talk...
别说话... (she kisses him)

[Scene: Rachel's bedroom]

Rachel: (waking up) Ehhh, aw!
（醒来）呃呃呃！ (pause).
（暂停）。 Well, that's new!
这倒是头一回。

[Scene: Hotel's room]

Ross: (on the phone) Hi, this is Ross Geller in suite 206.
（电话中）嗨，我是 206 套房的罗斯·盖勒 (Ross Geller)。 It seems you forgot a couple of things.
看来你忘记了几件事。 Could you have some complimentary toiletries sent up to my room?
您可以将一些免费洗漱用品送到我的房间吗？ (pause) Thank you!
（停顿）谢谢！ Ok.
好的。 Toothbrush, toothpaste, razor, mouthwash, deodorant, dental floss, band aids, shaving cream, after shave...
牙刷、牙膏、剃须刀、漱口水、除臭剂、牙线、创可贴、剃须膏、须后水…… and I feel like I am forgetting something...
而且我感觉我好像忘记了什么…… Is there anything else you have that I haven't asked for already?
你还有什么我还没要求的吗？ (pause) Yeah, go ahead, send up some tampons.
（停顿）是的，去吧，送一些卫生棉条。

(Chandler enters the room)

Ross: What did you get?
你得到了什么？

Chandler: USA Today
今日美国

Ross: Nice, put it with the others.
不错，和其他的放在一起。

Chandler: And I also got...
而且我还得到了... two more apples.
还有两个苹果。

Ross: We are four short of a bush-o (pause).
再来四个苹果就凑满一蒲式耳了。 God I feel so alive, I love being in the country!
天哪，我感觉自己还活着，我喜欢呆在乡下！

Chandler: I also got this great salt and pepper shaker from the restaurant.
我还从餐厅买了这个很棒的盐罐和胡椒瓶。

Ross: Oh, that's not cool.
哦，那不酷。

Chandlers: Dude, none of this is cool.
伙计，这一切都不酷。

Ross: No, Chandler, you have to find the line between stealing and taking what the hotel owes you.
不，钱德勒，你必须找到偷窃和拿走酒店欠你的东西之间的界限。 For example: hair drier, no, no, no, but shampoo and conditioners, yes, yes, yes.
例如：吹风机，不，不，不，但是洗发水和护发素，是，是，是。 (pause) Now, the salt shaker is off-limits, but the salt (he opens the salt shaker and pours the salt into his hand) I wish I'd thought this through.
（停顿）现在，盐瓶是禁止入内的，但盐（他打开盐瓶，将盐倒进手里）我希望我能想清楚这一点。

Chandler: I think I know what you mean though...the lamp is the hotel's, but the bulbs (goes to take the bulb)...oh, you already got that.
我想我明白你的意思……灯是酒店的，但灯泡（去拿灯泡）……哦，你已经明白了。

Ross: Not my first time in a hotel, my friend.
我的朋友，这不是我第一次住酒店。

Chandler: Ok, how about this (picks up the remote control)?
好吧，这个怎么样（拿起遥控器）？

Ross: No, no, no, you can't take the remote control!
不不不，你不能拿遥控器！

Chandler: Yes, but the batteries...
是的，但是电池...

(Ross claps his hands)

Chandler: Thank you, thank you very much!
谢谢您，非常感谢！

Ross: Let's celebrate with some maple candy!
让我们用一些枫糖来庆祝吧！

Chandler: No!
不！

Ross: At least tell me where you hid it.
至少告诉我你把它藏在哪里了。

[Scene: Central Perk. Monica and Rachel are sitting on the sofa]

Rachel: Can I ask you a question?
我可以问你一个问题吗？

Monica: Yeah.
是的。

Rachel: Have you ever had any weird romantic dreams?
你曾经做过什么奇怪的浪漫梦吗？

Monica: Let me think.
让我想想。 Oh, when I was younger I used to dream that I got married to Mayor McCheese, and on our wedding night I ate his head.
哦，当我年轻的时候，我常常梦见我和麦奇斯市长结婚，在新婚之夜我吃了他的头。

Rachel: Ok, well this is like that...in no way.
好吧，跟那个梦……完全不一样。 I had a...I had a dream last night that I wanted to kiss Joey.
我昨晚做了一个梦，梦见我想亲吻乔伊。

Monica: Wow, do you mean like kiss him-kiss him?
哇，你的意思是吻他——吻他吗？

Rachel: Oh yeah!
噢耶！ I mean, that was pretty intense.
我的意思是，那是相当激烈的。

Monica: What do you think brought than on?
你认为带来了什么？

Rachel: I don't know!
我不知道！ I mean, maybe that's something to do with the fact that I saw him do a love scene yesterday.
我的意思是，也许这与我昨天看到他演爱情戏有关。

Monica: A love scene?
爱情戏？ With who?
与谁？

Rachel: Olivia.
奥利维亚。

Monica: Olivia?
奥利维亚？ I thought she was marrying Connor!
我以为她要嫁给康纳了！ (pause) Oh right, real life more important.
（停顿）哦，对了，现实生活更重要。

Rachel: So do you think that my dream means anything?
那你觉得我的梦有什么意义吗？

Monica: I don't know.
我不知道。 I mean, you saw him do a love scene, so maybe you don't have a thing for Joey, maybe you have a thing for Drake.
我的意思是，你看到他演了一场爱情戏，所以也许你不喜欢乔伊，也许你喜欢德雷克。

Rachel: Ah!
啊! Well it was Joey reading Drake's lines in the dream...
嗯，是乔伊在梦中读德雷克的台词……

Monica: Of course it was!
当然是！ Trust me, when it comes to psychology I know what I'm talking about.
相信我，当谈到心理学时，我知道我在说什么。 I took two psych classes in college.
我在大学里选修了两门心理学课程。

Rachel: You took the same class twice.
你参加了同一门课两次。

Monica: It was hard!
很难！

(Phoebe comes in)

Phoebe: Hey!
嘿！

Rachel and Monica: Hi.
你好。

Phoebe: Here, Monica, look what I got to wear when I play at the restaurant (she dons a top hat) uh, huh wait!
来吧，莫妮卡，看看我在餐厅玩的时候穿什么（她戴着高顶帽子）呃，等等！ (she raises a pair of spectacles to her eyes) Right?
（她举起一副眼镜）对吧？ I mean, this might even class up the ballad of the uncircumcised man.
我的意思是，这甚至可能使未受割礼的男人的民谣更加优雅。

Monica: Oh...Phoebe?
哦……菲比？ Maybe I wasn't clear before.
可能是我之前没说清楚。 I really love listening to your music here, but my restaurant is sort of an upscale place.
我真的很喜欢在这里听你的音乐，但我的餐厅有点高档。

Phoebe: Right, yeah, ok, I'll ask the butler to fetch my diamonds out of the vault.
好的，好的，好的，我会让管家把我的钻石从金库里取出来。

Monica: Phoebe, it's not what you wear.
菲比，这不是你穿的。 It's sort of your songs...
有点像你的歌... I just don't think you should play at the restaurant anymore.
我觉得你以后还是别在餐厅演奏了。

Phoebe: Oh, ok.
哦，好吧。 Fine, I'll just, I'll take the hat back (she puts the hat in a bag and she crushes it angrily on the floor with her foot).
好吧，我就，我把帽子拿回来（她把帽子放进袋子里，然后生气地用脚把它踩在地板上）。

(silence)

Rachel: Hey, so you guys, the funniest thing happened, at work...
嘿，你们，最有趣的事情发生了，在工作中......

Phoebe: My songs aren't good enough for your restaurant?
我的歌不够好，适合你们的餐厅吗？

Rachel: Ok, we're still on that.
好的，我们还在讨论这个问题。

Monica: I didn't say your songs were not good enough.
我没有说你的歌不够好。

Phoebe: Then what's wrong with them?
那他们到底是怎么了？ Would they not go with your tiny portions of pretentious food?
他们不会和你的小份自命不凡的食物搭配吗？

Monica: Tiny portions?
小份？

Phoebe: Yeah well, "excuse me, I ordered the smoked salmon appetizer, but (peering through her spectacles) I can't see it, I can't see it"!
是的，好吧，“对不起，我点了熏鲑鱼开胃菜，但是（透过她的眼镜）我看不到它，我看不到它”！

Monica: Phoebe, it's not about quantity.
菲比，这不是数量的问题。

Phoebe: Well...it's not about quality.
嗯……这与质量无关。

Monica: Oh really, you want to talk about quality?
哦，真的，你想谈谈质量吗？ Have you heard of a key?
你听说过“调子”吗？ It's what some people sing in.
有的人唱歌是能唱在调上的。

Phoebe: Well at least all my songs don't taste like garlic.
好吧，至少我所有的歌曲尝起来都不像大蒜。 Yeah, there are other ingredients Monica.
是的，莫妮卡还有其他成分。

Monica: Ok, so that's what we're doing.
好的，这就是我们正在做的事情。 You know, when I'm in the coffee house bopping along to one of your songs, I'm wearing ear plugs.
你知道，当我在咖啡馆里跟着你的一首歌曲跳动时，我戴着耳塞。

Phoebe: Ear plugs, or cloves of garlic?
耳塞，还是大蒜？

Monica: You know what?
你知道吗？ I take back what I said before.
我收回之前的话。 You keep playing at the restaurant, because with your music driving people inside, my bar sales are going up like crazy.
你一直在餐厅里演奏，因为你的音乐驱使人们进去，我的酒吧销售额疯狂增长。

Phoebe: What are people having, the garlic Martini?
人们喝什么，大蒜马提尼？

[Scene: Hotel's reception]

Receptionist: Here's your copy of the bill, we hope you enjoyed your stay.
这是您的账单副本，希望您住得愉快。

Chandler: Oh we did, and you still have all your lamps.
哦，我们做到了，你仍然拥有所有的灯。

(the receptions is puzzled. She goes in the back.)

Chandler: Oh, I didn't factor in the room tax.
哦，我没有考虑房税。

Ross: Oh dude, don't worry about it, I found an unattended maid's car.
别担心，我发现了一辆没人看着的客房清洁车。 We're way ahead of the game.
我们在比赛中遥遥领先。

(they make as if to go, but Ross notices something)

Ross: Oh my god.
我的天啊。

Chandler: What?
什么？

Ross: There's something new in the bowl.
碗里有新东西。

Chandler: Look, we have enough, just walk away.
听着，我们已经够了，走吧。

Ross: No, but I want...I want the pinecones!
不，但我想要……我想要松果！

Chandler: There's a forest right outside.
外面有一片森林。

Ross: It's not the same.
这不一样。

Chandler: Ok, go quick!
好的，快点！

(Ross starts stuffing pinecones in the suitcase. As the receptionist walks in, Chandler makes a bird's verse and Ross stops)

Ross: (to the receptionist) Thank you for a delightful stay.
（对接待员）感谢您给我们带来愉快的住宿体验。

(he picks up the suitcase, which falls open, revealing all the stuff they have taken from the hotel. The receptionist just looks at them.)

Ross: Oh, my maple candy!
哦，我的枫糖！

[Scene: In front of Monica's restaurant. Phoebe is playing]

Phoebe: (singing) Food here at 'Javu'..will kill you..the food here at 'Javu' ...will kill you..
（唱歌）“Javu”这里的食物..会杀了你..“Javu”这里的食物...会杀了你..

(Monica comes out)

Monica: Thank god, it's just you!
感谢上帝，只有你！ I thought someone was swinging a bag of cats against the wall.
我还以为有人提着一袋猫往墙上甩呢。

Phoebe: You'd better get back in that kitchen Monica, the garlic is not gonna overuse itself.
莫妮卡，你最好回到厨房，大蒜不会过度使用。

Monica: Ok, you have to stop playing now.
好吧，你现在必须停止玩了。

Phoebe: Why?
为什么？ The only person my playing is bothering is you!
我的演奏唯一打扰的人就是你！

Monica: Oh yeah?
哦，是吗？ Ok, let's settle this, come on!
好吧，我们就解决这个问题吧，加油！

Phoebe: (while Monica drags her in the restaurant) Get your garlic-peelers off me!
（莫妮卡拖她进餐厅）把你那双剥蒜的手拿开！

Monica: (to the restuarant customers) Excuse me, excuse me, hi, I'm Monica Geller..
（对餐厅顾客）打扰一下，大家好，我叫莫妮卡·盖勒……I'm the head chef here..
我是这里的主厨…… (pauses as if waiting for something)..
（停顿好像在等待什么）.. Ok, I was actually expecting a little applause there, but whatever!
好吧，我其实期待着会有一点掌声，但无论如何！ Ok, quick question: by a show of hands, how many of you were bothered by this woman's singing outside?
好的，快速提问：请举手，你们中有多少人被这个女人在外面唱歌所困扰？ (a few people raise their hands)

Phoebe: Ok, ok, how many of you enjoyed the music outside?
好吧，好吧，你们中有多少人喜欢外面的音乐？ (a few people raise their hands) Ha!
（几个人举手）哈！

Monica: Alright, let me ask you this question: How many of you thought the music was fine, but not in keeping with the tone of the restaurant?
好吧，我问你们这个问题：有多少人觉得音乐不错，但不符合餐厅的基调？ (a few raise their hands again).
（一些人再次举手）。

Phoebe: Ok, well, who identified the tone of this restaurant as pretentious comma garlicky?
好吧，谁认为这家餐厅的基调是自命不凡的逗号蒜味？

Monica: Ok who thinks the food is delicious and a little pretention never hurt anyone?
好吧，谁认为食物很美味，一点点做作不会伤害任何人呢？ (a few raise their hands)

Phoebe: Ok, well, alright, who thinks the food is fine, the music was fine, but your evening was ruined by this incessant poll taking?
好吧，好吧，好吧，谁认为食物很好，音乐很好，但你的夜晚却被这种不断的民意调查毁了？ (all raise their hands).
（全部举手）。

Monica: Excuse us!
对不起！ (then to Phoebe) Alright here's a question: Who was so worried about her restaurant being fancy that she made a big deal about her friend playing her music and feels really bad about it now?
（然后对菲比）好吧，这里有一个问题：谁如此担心她的餐厅太豪华，以至于她对她的朋友播放她的音乐大为小觑，现在感觉真的很糟糕？ (raises her hand)

Phoebe: Oh...Who was so stupid and stubborn that she lashed out against her friend's cooking which she actually thinks is pretty great!
哎哟……谁这么傻，这么固执，竟然对朋友做的饭菜大骂，自己其实觉得还不错啊！ (raises her hand)

Monica: I'm sorry...
对不起...

Phoebe: I'm sorry too...
我也很抱歉... (they hug)

Monica: ooohh...
噢... hey!
嘿！ Wanna stick around and I'll whip you up some dinner?
想留下来我给你做点晚饭吗？

Phoebe: Yeah!
是的！ As long as it's free!
只要是免费的！ Food here is ridiculously over-p...
这儿的饭菜价钱实在高得离……

(Monica seems to take it amiss)

Phoebe: (smiling, raising her hand) Who's hoping the hand raising thing is still cute enough that you won't hate me?
（微笑着举手）谁希望举手的东西还那么可爱，你不会恨我？

[Scene: Joey and Rachel's apartment, Rachel walks in]

Rachel: Hey!
嘿！

Joey: Hey!
嘿！

Rachel: Joey, do you have peanut butter on the back of your head?
乔伊，你的后脑勺上有花生酱吗？

Joey: (Touches the back of his head and licks his fingers) Oh man!
（摸着后脑勺，舔手指）天啊！ I thought I got it all!
天哪，我以为全擦干净了！

Rachel: (looks puzzled) How...how...?
（一脸困惑）怎么……怎么……？

Joey: I was making a peanut butter smoothy, right?
我正在做花生酱冰沙，对吗？

Rachel: uh-huh
嗯嗯

Joey: And I couldn't find this little plastic thing (holds up plastic thing) that goes on top of the blender...and I thought...well...
我找不到搅拌机顶部的这个小塑料东西（支撑塑料东西）......我想......好吧...... how important can that be, right...?
这有多重要，对吧……？ Turns out very!
结果非常！

Rachel: (to herself) Wow...definitely just Drake...
（自言自语）哇……绝对是德雷克……

Joey: What?
什么？

Rachel: What...how is it going with Drake?
德雷克怎么样了？

Joey: Oh...I don't think it's going very well...
哦……我觉得事情不太顺利……

Rachel: What...that scene I saw was so good!
什么……我看到的那一幕真是太好了！

Joey: Well, I'm feeling really insecure about the one we are shooting tomorrow...
好吧，我对我们明天要拍摄的那个感到非常没有安全感......

Rachel: Joey, is this that thing that you do when you say you're bad so I'll give you a compliment?
乔伊，这就是你说自己不好让我夸奖你的做法吗？

Joey: A little.
一点。 Yeah no, I really am worried, you know, I mean I have to make it convincing that I'm in love with Olivia.
是的，不，我真的很担心，你知道，我的意思是我必须让人相信我爱上了奥利维亚。

Rachel: So?
所以？

Joey: So...I've never played that!
我从来没演过这种感情。

Rachel: Ooh!
哦！ Honey, it can't be that hard, I mean, you've been in love before?
亲爱的，这没那么难，我是说，你以前恋爱过吗？

Joey: Uh...well...just once...with you...
呃，就有过一次……爱上你那次……

Rachel: Ok...this could be a little awkward...
好吧，这可能会有点尴尬……I'm just going to blow past it...
我就直接跳过去了…… well can't you just use that method actor thing where you use your real life memories to help you in your performance?
那么你就不能使用演员的方法，用现实生活中的记忆来帮助你的表演吗？

Joey: (looks at her for a moment) What the hell are you talking about??
（看着她一会儿）你到底在说什么？

Rachel: (shakes her head) Alright, alright look, just uh...
（摇头）好吧，好吧，看吧，只是呃…… just try to remember how you felt when you were in love, and think about that when you're playing the scene.
试着回忆一下恋爱时的感受，并在表演场景时思考一下。

Joey: (approvingly) Oh!
（赞同）哦！ ok, yeah, I think I can do that.
好的，是的，我想我能做到。 Yeah ok, there's this party scene coming up..
是的，好吧，派对场景即将到来.. and Olivia and her husband are there and all Drake wants to do is grab her and kiss her, but he can't...
奥利维亚和她的丈夫就在那里，德雷克想做的就是抓住她并亲吻她，但他不能…… And that makes me think about all those times when I wanted to grab you and kiss you, but you didn't know so I would just pretend everything was cool, but really, it was killing me.
这让我想起那些时候我想抓住你并亲吻你，但你不知道，所以我只是假装一切都很酷，但实际上，这让我很痛苦。

Rachel: (looks touched) Joey, you never..you never talked about that before...
（看起来很感动）乔伊，你从来没有……你以前从来没有谈过这个……

Joey: Well..
嗯…… hey, you know what else I could use?
嘿，你知道我还能用什么吗？ There's a scene where Drake sneaks into Olivia's bedroom, and she doesn't know he's there - which never happened with us!
有一个场景是德雷克潜入奥利维亚的卧室，而她不知道他在那里——这在我们身上从未发生过！ And he knows he shouldn't be there, but he just wants to look at her...
他知道他不应该在那里，但他只是想看看她…… you know?
你知道？ (In a romantic voice) And I remember all those mornings before you even put on your make-up, when I would think to myself, my God, she...is...
（用浪漫的声音）我记得在你化妆之前的那些早晨，我心里想，我的上帝，她……是…… beautiful...
美丽的... (Rachel looks very moved) and it hurts so much, cuz I knew I could never tell you (pauses, while looking at her with sentiment) but it was worth it just to be there looking at you.
（瑞秋看起来很感动）这太痛苦了，因为我知道我永远无法告诉你（停顿，充满感情地看着她）但只要在那里看着你就值得了。

(Joey and Rachel continue to look at each other in silence for a while)

Joey: (excited) Thanks dude!!!
（兴奋地）谢谢，老兄！！！This is GREAT!!
这太棒了！！ (leaves Rachel very touched on the couch and goes into his room)

Closing credits

[Scene: Monica and Chandler's apartement, Monica is at the kitchen table writing something and Chandler enters kitchen area]

Chandler: I got you something from Vermont!
我从佛蒙特州给你带了一些东西！ (Sits down at the table)

Monica: (without looking up from what she's doing) Besides tampons and salt?
（头也不抬）除了卫生棉条和盐？ (Then looks) Ooh!
（然后看着）哦！ My God!
我的上帝！ Maple candy!
枫糖！ That's so sweet of you.
你真可爱。 (Opens the box) That's weird...it's empty!
（打开盒子）太奇怪了……里面是空的！

(Then Ross enters)

Ross: (sounds excited) Hi you guys!
（听起来很兴奋）大家好！ what's going on, you...
这是怎么回事，你... you guys wanna hang out...or...?
你们想出去玩……还是……？ (Looks around the room nervously) do you...do you guys hear a buzzing?
（紧张地环视房间）你们……你们听到嗡嗡声了吗？
